headline: Gold Trades Near $3,730 Following Hawkish Fed Signals and FOMC Minutes
summary: Gold traded near $3,730 an ounce after briefly dipping below $3,700 as FOMC minutes and Governor Waller reinforced expectations for further US rate hikes.
why: Precious metals are highly sensitive to US monetary policy signals, with higher interest rates increasing the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding bullion.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Hawkish Federal Reserve rate-hike signals pressure non-yielding gold prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Expectations of further US interest rate hikes reinforced by FOMC minutes increased borrowing costs and strengthened the dollar, pressuring gold bullion.
